name: 11368 · Corona, NY
findings: ZIP 11368 (Corona) has 167 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11368 (Corona) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
82% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
